identify: The adult is a small insect with a light yellow body and pure white wings.
The adults are found on the underside of the leaves.
damage: The leaves show spots, turn yellow, curl downward and dry. The whitefly spreads the tomato leaf curl disease.

thresholds.etl: Cotton: More than 10 whiteflies found in middle region of the plant in >50% (two out of four) of plants.

cultural: Use yellow sticky traps or cards at 10/acre.
Raise barrier crops such as maize or sorghum around the field.
biological: Protect the parasitoids and the predators of the whitefly in the field.
